headline: Portland Public Schools board to review personnel items, a High School for the Future state application, and the Special Education Coordinator contract ratification.
summary: The board will review personnel changes including resignations and new teacher hires, hear a presentation on the High School for the Future State Application, take a second read of the Comprehensive Emergency Management Plan, and vote on ratifying the Special Education Coordinator Collective Bargaining Agreement. The board will also enter Executive Session to discuss negotiations with the Special Education Coordinators and hold a workshop on the Role of the Board.
